title: approvals: no wire-door conformance case and no checklist clause for the reason-required reject on the email action link
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · contract review 7101851923 on PR #36695 (#35722), nit N4, filed on seat 3's request (#32588 comment 7101877978). Parent topic #36243.

## What is missing

- No case in `packages/qa/http-conformance` drives the `400` confirm page (`reason_required`) through dispatcher + hono.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` has no clause for the reject reason on the link. Its redemption step still reads "comment 'Via action link'" without saying that this is approve-only.

## Done when

- A conformance case posts a reject with no or blank `comment` and expects the `400` confirm page; a reject with a reason redeems.
- The checklist gains a clause for the link reject reason, and the redemption step says approve-only.

Triage: lands in `area:workflow` · `domain:server` · `priority:p3` · Task · `pm:queue`; rationale: a coverage gap on behaviour that works today (unit-tested in #36695), so p3. It is kept because the wire door is where a regression would first be seen.
